outcome: placental DNA methylation of PPARGC1A promoter
cord blood DNA methylation of PPARGC1A promoter
cohort: The cohort consisted of 58 mothers who underwent uncomplicated Caesarean delivery in a university hospital.
finding: Maternal gestational glucose levels positively correlated with placental DNA methylation and negatively correlated with cord blood DNA methylation of the PPARGC1A promoter in a CpG site-specific manner.
cross-section timing: Maternal glucose concentration was determined at 24-28 weeks of gestation, and placenta tissue and cord blood were collected immediately after delivery.
